notes: 1.1.170: 956 Check no longer says 'Live' on a page that was still loading - it waits for the real screen, types the email code and proves the unlock on Facebook's home; the 'Happy Birthday - new settings' page that hides a 956 lock is seen and the unlock runs from the lock's own start page; phone-only locks are named in seconds; name capture skips locked accounts; share works on the two-step 'Write post' (Next then Post); 'sleep mode' dialog closed; app close no longer freezes; an update now installs even if the exe is still running.
